tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground and default card fill. Every slide and screen sits on it; the one dark slide per story flips to the dark value.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, form panels and inner panels sitting on `surface-subtle`. Pair with `border` and `shadow-card`.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Step-card container, window chrome bar, pill chips. Body text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted` (4.7:1 on light).

tokens.name: surface-wash
tokens.usage: Dropzone fill and 'waiting' (not yet fillable) fields. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary button fill; also line-icon strokes and the hill curve. On `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-subtle`, `surface-wash`, `gold` (4.8:1 as text on gold).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, step labels, supporting lines, footnotes. On `surface`, `surface-subtle` and `surface-raised` it holds 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and lead-ins at 28px and above ('Today', 'This is', 'Persona:'). Large text only: 2.8:1 on white in light, so it misses even the 3:1 large-text floor there; the source uses it this way. Never use for text under 24px.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and dashed dropzone outlines. Decorative: 1.9:1 on white, below 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for control outlines; kept exact to the source. Never carries the only copy of an instruction.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and field hairlines (1px), tile outlines, the small hill curve. Decorative boundary at 1.45:1 on white; kept exact to the source, so pair fields with a visible label.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty progress segments and window-chrome dots. Decorative only.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled button ('Submit' while waiting for you). Inactive controls are exempt from contrast rules; always paired with a 'Waiting for you' style hint.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The single accent: emphasised phrases at 24px+ bold, check badges, the ball, progress fill, signal arcs, active field outline, Approve fill. Text on it is `on-gold`. Light value is 3.5:1 on white: fine for large text and graphics (3:1), not for small text — use `gold-strong` there. Dark value is the pale yellow of the dark slide (12:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: gold-strong
tokens.usage: Gold for small text (12–23px): hints like 'Required', gold labels. 5.4:1 on `surface`, 4.9:1 on `surface-subtle`, 5.2:1 on `gold-tint`. Derived by darkening `gold` for contrast; not in the source.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and check-mark strokes placed on `gold` fills (4.8:1 light, 12:1 dark). The source puts white on gold at small sizes, which fails; this token fixes it.

tokens.name: gold-mid
tokens.usage: Middle arc of the NFC signal and the 2nd step of any gold fade. Graphic only.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Outer arc of the NFC signal, relief tint in the cover. Graphic only.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Warm wash fading in at the right edge of the title slide; selected-row tint. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Objects that stay dark in every theme: the passport body, black section bars on paper forms, the phone body.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The paper form sheet; stays white in dark themes because it depicts a physical sheet.

tokens.name: paper-alert
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the red SSN boxes on the W-9 paper form (the friction being criticised). 3.9:1 on white as a graphic. Never used for Sisyphus's own validation states, which use gold.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Title-slide and pivot statements. Light weight; the key phrase switches to 700 (and `gold`).
styles.sample: Let Sisyphus save you some time.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Persona and problem statements, one idea per slide. Bold + `gold` on the payoff phrase.
styles.sample: The signup asks for SSN she doesn't have.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Stat and claim slides ('Only 62% of people follow-through…'). 700 + `gold` on the number.
styles.sample: A debt-collection startup faced 200 to 240 lawsuits yearly

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Supporting paragraph under a display statement, in `ink-muted`, bold fragments for emphasis.
styles.sample: So she uploads a passport photo and a selfie; waits for approval.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Lead-in above a statement ('Today', 'This is', 'Introducing'), in `ink-subtle`. 700 when it names the idea.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Citation line, bottom-left of the slide, italic, `ink-muted`.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Card and form titles ('Create your account').

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between progress segments, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field inner padding, row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card gaps, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, step-card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Slide-edge gutters on small canvases.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Slide gutters, space around a statement.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Slide outer margin on the 1920 canvas.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, icon tiles, dropzones.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Step-card containers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Approve/Edit pills, assistant chip, status pills, progress segments.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Form cards, approval and verified cards: a 1px edge plus a soft 24px fall-off.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Tilted (±3°) card collage on the title slide and floating overlays.
